Explain GHOST and why it improves on longest-chain.

drill: Does a chain prevent a double spend?
No — it orders the two spends and rejects the later one
What do confirmations add?
Depth; reversal gets progressively costlier
With n = 10, how many Byzantines tolerated?
f = 3, since n ≥ 3f + 1
What makes a fault Byzantine?
It may lie, not merely crash
What do PoW and PoS both do?
Make identity expensive — Sybil resistance
Which has deterministic finality?
PoS at checkpoints
Which does a blockchain sacrifice under partition?
Availability on the minority side
What bounds the EVM?
Gas — the meter reaches the limit and reverts
What does an out-of-gas halt still cost?
The gas fee
What does GHOST score?
Total accumulated difficulty of the subtree
When does a Sybil attack work?
Wherever identity is free to create
Why do pools exist?
Solo mining variance is too high
What power does a pool operator have?
Choosing which transactions enter the block
Reentrancy fix?
Update state before the external call
Why is tx.origin unsafe?
A phishing contract in the middle satisfies it
Why are bigger blocks not free scaling?
They raise validation cost and centralise the network
What decides L2 security inheritance?
Whether its data is posted to L1
